北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，今天有点热，风力不小，注意防晒和补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's a bit hot and windy. Stay hydrated and use sun protection!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，气温适中，但风力不小，户外活动注意防风。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny with pleasant temps, but windy. Mind the wind outdoors!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感舒适。微风拂面，享受美好的一天吧！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels nice. Enjoy the lovely day with a light breeze!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感炎热，湿度较高，请多喝水，防范中暑哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels hot and humid. Stay hydrated to avoid heatstroke!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳小雨绵绵，湿度高。出门带伞，小心路滑，注意防潮！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has light rain and high humidity. Take an umbrella, watch for slips!
深圳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，气温 31℃。紫外线强，记得防晒补水哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and warm. Strong UV in the afternoon, remember sun protection and hydration!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感舒适。湿度适中，享受这宜人的一天吧！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and feels pleasant. Enjoy this nice day with moderate humidity!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都今天体感炎热，请注意防晒降温，多喝水哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu feels hot today. Stay cool, protect from sun, and drink plenty of water!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 30℃ 左右。风力不小，注意防晒和补水！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels around 30℃. It's windy, mind sun protection and hydration!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴热干燥，气温 34℃。请务必多喝水，注意防晒哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is hot, sunny, and dry, 34℃. Be sure to drink plenty of water and use sun protection!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，湿度很高。体感凉爽，但也要注意防潮哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy with very high humidity. It feels cool, but mind the dampness!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阳光明媚，气温 27℃，体感舒适。享受美好的一天吧！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny with pleasant 27℃ temps. Enjoy your beautiful day!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，气温 29℃，体感舒适。外出记得防晒哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and 29℃, feels comfortable. Remember sun protection when out!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明小雨，气温 20℃，体感凉爽。记得带伞，注意保暖哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has light rain, 20℃, feels cool. Take an umbrella and stay warm!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门大雨倾盆，湿度极高！出门务必带伞，注意交通安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has heavy rain and extreme humidity! Take an umbrella, drive safely.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 23℃ 凉爽。风力不小，外出加件外套吧！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and cool at 23℃. It's windy, wear a jacket when out!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 22℃ 凉爽。风力大，出门注意防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and cool at 22℃. It's windy, mind the wind and stay warm!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃
